title: Texting your best friend... feelings
old_caption:
Catching feelings for your best friend.
Some words deserve a face, not a screen.

title: Their time: 4 a.m.
old_caption:
When it's evening for you and 4 a.m. for them.
Send the soft one. It will still be there when they wake.

title: Making a friend as an adult
old_caption:
Why is asking a new friend to hang out so scary?
Friendship needs asking too.

title: Five unsent texts, one night
old_caption:
Five texts drafted, four never sent. Wait for the last one.
The drafts show you what you actually mean.

title: One text, all night
old_caption:
One text, rewritten from 11 p.m. to 9 a.m.
The angry drafts faded. The true one kept.

title: Friday Night: Out All Night vs In by Nine
old_caption:
2016 Sagittarius: three parties and pancakes at 2 a.m.
2026 Sagittarius: in bed by nine, breakfast for the same crew. Which Friday are you living right now?

title: Waiting Up for Their Reply
old_caption:
Sent "had fun today!" at 7. In 2016 that meant refreshing until 1 a.m.
In 2026 Gemini made dinner, went out and read the reply at breakfast. Which era are you in?

title: Two Hours Picking a Film
old_caption:
Ten years of couch nights. Two hours choosing, four minutes awake. Every single time.
The movie was never the point. Who falls asleep first in your house?

title: The Singles Table at the Wedding
old_caption:
2016: Virgo hid behind the flowers at the singles table.
2026: Virgo made joke name cards and led the conga line. Same table, very different energy. Which seat are you?

title: Leo's Birthday: Sixty Guests vs Four
old_caption:
Sixty guests in 2016 and Leo still watched the door all night.
Four friends in 2026 and nobody left before 1 a.m. Big party or small table?
